instruction: Check Dickinson_Slides.pptx for slides containing speaker notes, and export those notes—one per line—to a document named 'notes_only.docx' on my Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting notes from slides with speaker notes and saving to a DOCX file. Evaluator verifies the DOCX has exactly 8 paragraphs (one per note) and that the content matches the expected notes from the source PPTX. Verified with Python: 8 slides have notes out of 9 total slides.
